title: Disappointed with Absorbancy
text: Disappointed with Absorbancy. These are generally pretty good looking towels, but I was very disappointed with them in action.  They are barely absorbant.  I thought that a wash might help but that caused them to get a little misshapened and not much more absorbant.  So look nice out of bag, but did not work particularly well for drying dishes or wiping counters.
